children: United Therapeutics entered into an accelerated share repurchase agreement with Citi to repurchase approximately $477.6 million of its common stock under its existing buyback program. The company will make an upfront payment of about $477.6 million around Sep 10, 2026 and receive an initial delivery of roughly 719,376 shares, or about 75% of the estimated total based on the Sep 8 closing price. The final share count will be determined by the average daily VWAP during the ASR term, less a discount, with settlement expected in Q4 2026.

title: United Therapeutics Launches $477.6 Million Accelerated Share Repurchase With Citi
